### Bible Pathway - March 30
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-mar-30-2013.html
Passage: Judges 20:26
Points:
- The tribe of Benjamin refused justice and shielded the guilty men of Gibeah, provoking civil war.
- Israel's initial military attacks ended in severe defeats because they had not first humbled themselves before God.
- Only after weeping, fasting, and presenting sacrifices at Bethel did God promise victory.
- A culture that redefines sin removes guilt, but believers must stand for biblical truth while praying for sinners.
- Genuine repentance brings complete cleansing and forgiveness through Christ, our Deliverer.

### At War with Benjamin
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/war-with-benjamin
Passage: Judges 20:35
Points:
- Israel rallied as a unified body only when confronted with an appalling moral atrocity.
- Benjamin abandoned covenant loyalty to God by choosing tribal solidarity over righteousness.
- Uprooting wickedness came at a tremendous cost, resulting in heavy casualties on both sides.
- Believers must never presume upon divine mercy or mistake God's patience for indifference toward sin.
- God is committed to purifying His people and will take drastic measures to discipline impenitent sin.

### Read the Bible: Judges 20, Acts 24, Jeremiah 34, and Psalms 5–6
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/judges-20-acts-24-jeremiah-34-psalms-5-6/
Passage: Judges 20
Points:
- Benjamin protected brutal criminals out of tribal loyalty rather than upholding moral principle.
- Israel acted rashly with foolish military strategies, suffering massive troop losses across the first two days.
- Success arrived only after the tribes sought God properly at the sanctuary and received His promise.
- The breakdown of shared moral truth and legal justice inevitably plunges society into violence and tyranny.
- Behind human corruption and war, God's sovereign hand actively sets limits on evil.
